children: IG Group Holdings' lower 2026 guidance is driven by lower over-the-counter income retention and a weaker market backdrop, RBC Capital Markets' Ben Bathurst says. The online trading platform's new 2026 revenue guidance suggests earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization between 490 million and 500 million pounds, RBC says, which would be 16% lower than the Canadian bank's estimates. "A lower than expected revenue retention rate of 70% for OTC business also looks to have been a material driver of the miss, but we note revenues would have been below our expectations irrespective of this, as there was an implicit 16% miss on non OTC revenues," the analyst adds. The lower retention follows a recent decision to hedge less of the OTC book, RBC added. Shares are down 22%. (michael.hennessey@wsj.com)
